draftQuestions.question: 按欧盟委员会 Digital Decade 2026 工作簿的 2025 年中数据，奥地利 Burgenland 地区的 VHCN（FTTP + DOCSIS 3.1）Overall 和 Rural 家庭覆盖率各约是多少？请分别写出覆盖户数与基数。
draftQuestions.calculation: O2/S2 and O3/S3, each multiplied by 100; rounded to two percentage decimals

draftQuestions.question: 按同一工作簿，Burgenland 农村家庭中，5G 3.4–3.8 GHz 频段覆盖户数与农村基数分别是多少，对应覆盖率约是多少？
draftQuestions.calculation: R3/S3 multiplied by 100; rounded to two percentage decimals

originalVisualReview.method: Opened the quarantined original in local Excel 16 read-only with link updates disabled and macros disabled. Exported Instructions, Report and Notes on the data and reuse to ignored local PDF review copies. The first print export split across columns; a second in-memory print-area/fit-to-page export produced one page per sheet. Rendered those PDFs to PNG and visually inspected each; no workbook save occurred.
originalVisualReview.instructions: The fitted Excel render visibly confirms the indicator definitions and selection instructions plus the European Commission logo. drawing1 OOXML also contains a regional-zero caveat, but its trailing Note on the data section was not visible in the fitted render; keep that text as XML-only evidence, not visually confirmed transcription.
originalVisualReview.report: The original Report has no Member State or reporting level selected. Its dynamic chart displays axes/legend and zero placeholders, with no regional series suitable as answer data. Its four pictures are a NUTS-level illustration, European Commission logo, Digital Decade 2026 banner and Connectivity Coverage in Europe 2025 cover. The cached table contains calculation errors while selectors are blank.
originalVisualReview.reuseNotes: The original legal-notice text shape is legible and matches drawing3 text: EU-authored workbook, CC BY 4.0 attribution/changes condition, possible third-party rights, and data-revision/accuracy caveats. Its accompanying picture is a European Commission logo.
originalVisualReview.reviewDecision: Keep all three visual-review records unresolved. Do not publish the original workbook or use the unselected Report chart as factual Gold. The two draft questions remain grounded only in Data source literal cells.
